forbidden_verbs.transfer: Use independent give / receive / hold; TRANSFER is not a single-hand verb

adapter_plate.en: Individual adapter/intermediate housing part. Former label: intermediate_housing. Count it in assembly only after the connection is completed.
adapter_plate.zh: 独立的转接/中间壳体零件，旧名intermediate_housing。连接完成后才加入assembly组成。

anti_vibration_handle.en: Individual anti-vibration side handle; its presence in assembly must be checked visually.
anti_vibration_handle.zh: 独立的防振侧手柄。是否已装入assembly需看画面确认。

assembly.en: Two or more parts with completed connections. Composition is maintained per physical instance ID; hands referencing the same ID share its state. Independent subassemblies use different IDs. At a confirmed merge, keep the receiving ID and end the inserted track. One remaining part uses its part noun. Add a two-screw connection after both screws are secured; remove the component at the first actual loosening.
assembly.zh: 两个及以上完成连接的零件。按物理实例ID维护组成，两手引用同一ID时共享状态；独立子装配体使用不同ID。合并完成后保留接收方ID，结束被并入者的独立轨迹。仅剩单件时用该零件名；双螺钉连接在两颗均拧紧稳定后增加组成，拆卸在第一颗实际松动时移除对应组成。

bearing_plate.en: Individual bearing plate/support part, distinct from adapter_plate. Former label: bevel_gear.
bearing_plate.zh: 独立的轴承支承板，与adapter_plate不同。旧名bevel_gear。

combination_wrench.en: Combination wrench/spanner. Merge the former wrench label into this category.
combination_wrench.zh: 两用扳手。旧wrench统一用此名。

crimp_plier.en: Crimping pliers used to compress a terminal onto wire.
crimp_plier.zh: 用于将端子压接到导线上的压接钳。

flat_head_screwdriver.en: Screwdriver with a flat/slotted tip. Former spelling: flathead_screwdriver.

gearbox_housing.en: Individual gearbox housing part, before composition with other completed attachments.
gearbox_housing.zh: 独立齿轮箱壳体零件。与其他零件完成连接后按共享组成记录。

lever.en: Individual lever of the A-model mechanism. Model B has no lever mechanism.
lever.zh: A型号机构中的独立拨杆；B型号没有此机构。

nut.en: Two physical nuts, one per screw_long slot; use separate instance IDs for HOI events. Each slot records one joint secured state for its screw_long and nut. Do not select nuts separately in the assembly component list.
nut.zh: 两颗独立螺母，分别对应两个screw_long孔位，HOI事件使用各自的实例ID。每个孔位只记录螺钉和螺母共同锁紧的状态，不在装配组成中重复勾选nut。

phillips_screwdriver.en: Screwdriver with a cross-shaped Phillips tip.

screw_black.en: Model B connection screw for bearing_plate–gearbox_housing. Distinguish physical IDs from Slot 1/2.
screw_black.zh: B型bearing_plate–gearbox_housing连接螺钉。实物ID与孔位1/2分开记录。

screw_lever.en: Screw belonging to the A-model lever mechanism.

screw_short.en: Model A connection screw for bearing_plate–gearbox_housing. Distinguish physical IDs from Slot 1/2.
screw_short.zh: A型bearing_plate–gearbox_housing连接螺钉。实物ID与孔位1/2分开记录。

screw_wrong.en: The different long screw identified for this study. Keep this annotator name until its professional name is confirmed. Category alone does not imply an anomalous event.
screw_wrong.zh: 本实验中那个不同的长螺钉。专业名称确认前保留此标注名；此名词本身不代表该event有异常。

spring.en: Individual spring. Distinguish a lever accessory from any independent spring by the visible part; the lever mechanism exists only in model A.
spring.zh: 独立弹簧。按画面区分lever配件与独立弹簧；lever机构仅存在于A型号。

terminal.en: Each wire has one terminal at each end. Use separate instance IDs for the two terminals.
terminal.zh: 同一根导线的两端各有一个端子，两颗端子分别使用实例ID。

torx_screwdriver_15.en: Torx screwdriver with TX15 tip; use the verified size rather than guessing from the handle.
torx_screwdriver_15.zh: TX15规格的Torx螺丝刀；按确认的规格选择。

torx_screwdriver_20.en: Torx screwdriver with TX20 tip; use the verified size rather than guessing from the handle.
torx_screwdriver_20.zh: TX20规格的Torx螺丝刀；按确认的规格选择。

washer.en: Individual washer placed around a fastener.

wire.en: Wire with no completed terminal crimp. An inserted terminal or a failed crimp does not complete the crimp.
wire.zh: 尚无任何一端完成端子压接的导线。仅放入端子或压接失败时保持此名称。

wire_crimped.en: Wire with at least one currently attached, successfully crimped end. Use the Wire state editor to record 1 or 2. Removing terminals changes the count on the same ID.
wire_crimped.zh: 至少一端仍连接着成功压接端子的导线。在Wire窗口记录完成端数1或2；剪去端子时修改端数，沿用原导线ID。

wire_cutter.en: Wire-cutting tool used to sever wire.
wire_cutter.zh: 用于切断导线的剪线工具。

wire_stripper.en: Wire-stripping tool used to remove insulation.
wire_stripper.zh: 用于去除导线绝缘层的剥线工具。

screwdriver.en: Legacy generic screwdriver. Select the visible tip category: Phillips, flat head, TX15 or TX20.
screwdriver.zh: 旧稿中的泛称螺丝刀。按可见刀头改为十字、一字、TX15或TX20。

pliers.en: Legacy generic pliers. Identify crimping, cutting or stripping function and select the actual tool.
pliers.zh: 旧稿中的泛称钳子。根据压接、剪切或剥线功能选择实际工具。

gear.en: Legacy ambiguous gear label. Verify the pictured part before replacing it with a standard noun.
gear.zh: 旧稿中的未明确gear名称。按画面确认具体零件后再选标准名词。

hand.en: Hand entity. Choose anatomical Left Hand or Right Hand; use a part/tool category for Object or instrument.
hand.zh: 手部实体。使用人的左手或右手；Object和instrument选择零件或工具。

left_hand.en: The person’s anatomical left hand, independent of screen position.
left_hand.zh: 人的生理左手，与画面左右位置无关。

right_hand.en: The person’s anatomical right hand, independent of screen position.
right_hand.zh: 人的生理右手，与画面左右位置无关。

screw_long.en: Standard long connection screw. Former noun: screw. Distinguish it from screw_wrong, the different long screw. Physical IDs and connection slots are separate; exact specification will be mapped later. Used with a nut to connect adapter_plate to gearbox_housing.
screw_long.zh: 标准长连接螺钉，旧名screw。与screw_wrong那颗不同规格的长螺钉区分。实物ID与连接槽位分开记录；具体规格后续统一映射。 用于adapter_plate与gearbox_housing连接，与对应nut共同锁紧。

pick_up.en: Acquire a free item from a surface/storage. Start: direct pickup approach; Onset: first grasp contact; End: controlled lift or final pickup effort. Hovering or resting a hand is not evidence of failure. An unsuccessful attempt requires an observable grasp/lift effort ending without acquisition.
pick_up.zh: 从桌面或存放处拿起物品。S为直接拾取接近开始；Onset为首次抓取接触；E为受控提起或最后拾取尝试结束。悬停、搭手本身不证明失败；明确抓取/提起尝试结束而未取得物品，才标未成功。

place.en: Place an item on a support or in a container. Start: placement begins; End: last placement stroke/control.
place.zh: 将物品放到支撑面或容器中。S为放置动作开始；E为最后放置动作或控制结束。

hold.en: Independent holding, supporting or carrying. Onset defaults to Start; the boundary remains adjustable. Holding inherent to another operation does not need a separate event.
hold.zh: 独立持握、支撑或携带。O默认等于S，可微调。其他操作中自带的持握无需另建hold事件。

give.en: Present and cooperatively release an item to the other hand. End at last control or final giving effort.
give.zh: 向另一只手交出物品。E为最后控制结束或交出尝试结束；两手动词分别填写。

receive.en: Take an item directly from the other hand. Start: direct approach; End: receiving action ends.
receive.zh: 直接从另一只手接过物品。S为直接接近开始；E为接取动作结束。

flip.en: Change the working face of an item. Start/End bound the face change; ordinary carrying/reorientation remains hold.
flip.zh: 翻转物品以切换工作面，S/E覆盖翻转过程；普通携带和调整朝向用hold。

align.en: Independent alignment to an identifiable reference. End before feeding/driving starts, or when alignment terminates.
align.zh: 独立对准可识别的参照位置。E为插入/驱动开始前一帧，或对准动作终止。

insert.en: Feed into a receiving hole/slot, including blocked attempts. Start: first inward feed; Onset: first part contact at the insertion target, including blocked contact; End: last feeding effort. Keep earlier attempts and their keyframes; do not move Onset to the final successful attempt.
insert.zh: 向接收孔或槽送入，包括受阻尝试。S为首次向内送入；Onset为零件首次接触插入目标，包括受阻接触；E为最后送入动作结束。保留前面尝试和关键帧，不把Onset移到最后成功的一次。

extract.en: Withdraw from a receiving hole/slot. Start: withdrawal begins; End: last withdrawal effort.
extract.zh: 从接收孔或槽拔出。S为拔出开始；E为最后拔出动作结束。

attach.en: Connect at an exposed mating face, end or hook. Start: connection begins; End: last connection effort. A free screw attached to a driver tip uses attach.
attach.zh: 在外露配合面、端部或挂接处连接。S为连接开始；E为最后连接动作结束。将独立螺钉接到螺丝刀头上用attach。

detach.en: Disconnect an exposed mating interface. Start: disconnection begins; End: last disconnection effort.
detach.zh: 断开外露配合界面的连接。S为断开开始；E为最后断开动作结束。

tighten.en: Drive a known thread in its fastening direction, by hand or tool. Start: first fastening stroke; End: final drive and integral return.
tighten.zh: 用手或工具沿已知螺纹紧固方向驱动。S为首次紧固动作；E包含最终驱动及同一操作的回程。

loosen.en: Drive a known thread in its release direction. Screen rotation alone is insufficient. Start: first release stroke; End: final drive and integral return.
loosen.zh: 沿已知螺纹松开方向驱动。不能只按画面旋转方向判断。S为首次松开动作；E包含最终驱动及同一操作的回程。

twist.en: Non-threaded relative axial/material twisting. Start: first relative twist; End: last twisting stroke.
twist.zh: 非螺纹紧固的相对轴向扭转或材料扭转。S为首次扭转；E为最后扭转动作结束。

pull.en: Apply tension to constrained material or draw out length. Prefer extract/detach/strip when one of those specific operations applies.
pull.zh: 对受约束材料施加拉力或拉出长度。符合extract、detach、strip时优先用具体动词。

press.en: Independent pressing of a button/latch/lever, or an unloaded handle reset/release. End includes integral return.
press.zh: 独立按压按钮、锁扣、拨杆，或空载手柄复位/释放；E包含同一操作的回程。

cut.en: Cut an actual target. Start: first cutting stroke; End: cut and integral return. Add a keyframe at separation.
cut.zh: 切断实际目标。S为首次切割动作；E包含切断及同一操作的回程。分离帧要补关键帧。

strip.en: Remove a covering in a stripping cycle. Start: first stripping stroke/cycle; End: the stripping cycle ends.
strip.zh: 通过剥除过程去掉覆盖层。S为首次剥除动作或周期开始；E为该周期结束。

crimp.en: Compress an actual terminal in a crimping cycle. Ratchet advances belong to the same cycle. Start: target-directed closing; End: final crimp and integral return. Failed attempts keep this verb.
crimp.zh: 在压接周期中压合实际端子；棘轮多次推进属于同一周期。S为朝目标合拢开始；E包含最终压接及回程。失败仍用crimp。

adjust.en: Legacy broad adjustment. Choose the executed operation, e.g. align, flip or twist.
adjust.zh: 旧稿中的泛称调整。按实际动作选择align、flip或twist等具体动词。

move.en: Legacy broad motion. Choose pick_up, place, hold, give or receive according to the interaction.
move.zh: 旧稿中的泛称移动。根据交互选择pick_up、place、hold、give或receive。

screw.en: Legacy thread operation. Reassess tightening, loosening or insertion from visible motion and thread engagement.
screw.zh: 旧稿中的泛称拧螺钉。按可见操作和螺纹啮合选择tighten、loosen或insert。

unscrew.en: Legacy unscrewing. Use loosen for thread release; use extract/detach for a separate removal phase.
unscrew.zh: 旧稿中的旋松。螺纹松开用loosen；独立拔出/断开阶段用extract或detach。

remove.en: Legacy generic removal. Select extract for withdrawal from a hole/slot, detach for interface separation, or loosen for thread release.
remove.zh: 旧稿中的泛称移除。从孔槽拔出用extract，断开配合界面用detach，螺纹松开用loosen。

wire.title: Wire
wire.new_label: Cut from coil: create a new wire ID
wire.help: Count completed ends, not pressing attempts. Cutting off a terminal changes 2 → 1 → 0 on this same wire ID. Only a separate piece cut from the coil gets a new ID. Keep the last confirmed state through occlusion. An unverified old wire_crimped label does not determine whether 1 or 2 ends are complete.
